chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: “Is there anything due concerning buffalo?” He said: “The same as what is due for cattle.”

key_terms.الْبَقَرِ: cattle or cows; the category whose ruling is applied to buffalo
key_terms.الْجَوَامِيسِ: buffalo; the animal being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: something due; an obligation or liability in context
key_terms.قَالَ: he said; introducing the Imam’s response
key_terms.مِثْلُ: the same as; indicating equivalence in legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on zakat for buffalo in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the obligation concerning buffalo is the same as the ruling concerning cattle. It is relevant to the fiqh of zakat, indicating that buffalo are treated like cows in this legal context.
